answer: Divergence probes: every fake needs its own independently tuned model, ~40 GPU-hours plus 3 clean epochs per identity. Each epoch the ledger sends a sealed ripple prompt to random key pairs; if two replies exceed 0.9 embedding similarity or share the same rare error, both keys go over the ledge into a slashed queue. Only after 3 clean probes does a key reach harbor status and earn. One model behind 500 keys answers alike and gets caught, so 500 fakes need 500 distinct models, about 20,000 GPU-hours. A rich farm can still pay; it just pays per head.
